correctness.rationale: Swaps are partitioned exactly by uniquely identifiable changed-coordinate supports: singleton edge, two disjoint edges, all-distinct overlapping triple, or one-equal-neighbor overlapping triple. The special cases aba/aaa, repeat swaps, and no-ops contribute nothing extra. Counts yield the exact formula for every n>=2. Pointwise bounds on triple contributions prove sharp maximum and equality characterization; indicator expectations yield exact mean and graph-edge total. An independent two-step BFS checked 88,397 words, exact finite means, max values and extremizer multiplicities. Finite exhaustive checks are supplementary, not the proof.

value.rationale: Repeated-letter adjacent-transposition balls are not vertex-transitive, so exact center-dependent radius-two ball volumes are a nontrivial parameter of the natural swap channel. The result supplies a linear-time exact evaluator, identifies every largest-ambiguity center for any alphabet size at least three, and determines the average and graph-edge density for arbitrary lengths, with plausible uses in packing/covering bounds and reliability of finite-alphabet synchronization codes. It does not assert any unproved packing optimum.
